stories.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
stories.summary: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

stories.title: 'Disturbed' by Cornell rape investigation, NY governor puts state AG in charge
stories.summary: The Cornell University Police Department is leading the investigation into an alleged gang rape two years ago. How effective is that approach, and is the campus police accountable to the public?

stories.title: How Brazil's two leading presidential candidates are talking about crime
stories.summary: Crime is at the top of voters' concerns in Brazil ahead of Sunday's national elections. Many are calling for tougher measures — part of a broader rightward shift across Latin America.

stories.title: Remembering Brooke Eby, the TikTok star who documented her ALS journey
stories.summary: After Brooke Eby was diagnosed with ALS, she started to document her experience. The influencer was perhaps best known for her humor. Now, four years after her official diagnosis, Eby has died.

stories.title: Talk of drones and a burning flame on Trump's D.C. arch worries aviation experts
stories.summary: Aviation safety experts were wary of Trump's proposed arch near D.C.'s airport. Then came the FAA's unusual lighting recommendations — including an eternal flame on top — and Trump's talk of drones.

stories.title: Drag queen Trixie Mattel has a new holiday album — but think Halloween, not Christmas
stories.summary: On Wild Card, well-known guests answer questions about topics we don't always talk about. Drag queen Trixie Mattel reflects on whether competition has been a positive or negative force in her life.
